Behavior: zero-fills the 32-entry u16 *actions output buffer, then dispatches on mode. mode==1: a single ascending pass over owner->action_slots[0..31], including an entry's raw encoded_action in the output (and incrementing the u8 return count) when Ability_GetData(encoded_action & 0x3FFF)[12] != 0. mode!=1 (called with mode==0 or mode==2 by other owners): an outer loop of outerCount=(mode!=2)?4:3 passes (categories 0..outerCount-1) each doing a fresh descending 32-iteration scan of the same action_slots array; category 0 includes an entry when ability[12]!=0 OR (ability[1]&0x40)!=0; categories 1 and 2 do the Ability_GetData lookup (side-effect only, evidenced by the reference re-loading/re-storing sp spill slots around the call every non-zero entry) but never include anything; category 3 includes an entry under the exact negated condition of category 0 (ability[12]==0 AND (ability[1]&0x40)==0). Matches the one confirmed real caller: games/gs1/src/psynergy_menu/refresh_owner_psynergy.c calls it with mode=2 to build the Psynergy-menu icon list for one owner.

Return type: the header declares 'u8', but the retained assembly returns the raw count in r0 with no truncation before the pop/bx (no lsl24/lsr24 or `and #0xff`), and my candidate only reproduces that byte-for-byte when the local definition's return type is s32 and the return statement is a bare `return count;` -- casting to (u8) or typing the local `count` as u8 both force an extra 2-4 byte truncation sequence that the reference does not have (the old compiler does not appear to prove count's range and elide the cast on its own; it only omits it when the static type already matches). Left games/gs1/include/psynergy_menu.h's declared 'u8' alone since that header is shared by already-adopted-exact callers (e.g. main:080a6384) and editing it risks perturbing their verified bytes for no benefit to this owner; this file instead defines the function locally as `s32 Func_080a68ec(...)` (not through the header's PsynergyMenu_CollectActions macro) and documents the real return type here.
